Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the generational chain. After noting that the 3rd Earl was the grandson of the 1st Earl, the Planner incorrectly concluded this “supports that the 1st Earl is the paternal grandfather of the 4th Earl.” In reality, the 4th Earl’s paternal grandfather is the father of the 3rd Earl—i.e., the 2nd Earl. This is a logical error in mapping relationships across generations.
